ValidationRule.description: Must select a reason for change for all lead purchasing values and the control spending value in General Account Inquiry.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Lead_Purchasing__c , "Adjust Hours"), ISPICKVAL( Lead_Purchasing__c , "Adjust Lead Types"), ISPICKVAL( Lead_Purchasing__c , "Adjust Volume Cap"), ISPICKVAL( Lead_Purchasing__c , "Adjust Zip Codes"), ISPICKVAL( Lead_Purchasing__c , "Lead Volume"), ISPICKVAL( General_Account_Inquiry__c , "Control Spending")),
ISPICKVAL( Reason_for_Change__c , ""), Datevalue(CreatedDate) > DATE(2017,04,01))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a reason for the change.
